name: Embed Origins
description: Add third-party embeds by hand: an Embed block for the canvas, plus the operator-approved origins that let the published page's Content-Security-Policy load them.

settings.label: Allowed iframe origins (frame-src)
settings.description: One origin per line, scheme included, e.g. https://reputationhub.site. Each is added to frame-src on every published page. Leave empty to change nothing.

settings.label: Allowed script origins (script-src)
settings.description: One origin per line. Only needed for widgets that inject their own <script src>. Every origin here can run arbitrary JavaScript on the site, so add only origins you trust.

settings.label: Allowed fetch/XHR origins (connect-src)
settings.description: One origin per line. Needed when a widget's script calls an API. Usually the same host as the script origin.
